data.name: Kismat
data.gender_notes: Kismat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The term Kismat refers to the belief in predetermined fate and the supernatural influence of the stars and planets on human life. It is derived from the Arabic word 'qismat' meaning 'portion' or 'lot'. The name is used to signify that the person is blessed with good fortune and is protected by the divine. The name Kismat carries the meaning “Fate, Destiny” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Kismat usually hope their child will grow to embody fate, destiny and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kismat is a spiritual name that signifies faith in the divine plan and the belief that one's life is predestined by a higher power. It is a reminder to trust in the universe and have faith that everything happens for a reason.
data.etymology: Kismat belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fate, Destiny.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kismat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
